description: a thin young woman with long straight black hair in a deep navy blue robe down to the feet patterned with small silver constellations, a silver crescent moon emblem on the chest, a high stiff collar, a dark wooden staff topped with a black crystal held upright and leaning back over the shoulder, no sparkles, sitting astride and riding in the pose of the grey mannequin, both hands in front holding the reins, seen from the side, facing right, only the near leg showing, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the foot inside the image, nothing under the rider, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
